name: Dumbbell Raise
description: Dumbbell Raise is a beginner strength movement performed with dumbbell. It primarily targets Shoulders and uses an isolation pattern; the listed source steps should be followed with a controlled range and steady breathing. Supporting muscles include Biceps.
descriptionAr: تمرين دمبل رفع من تمارين القوة، ويُنفَّذ باستخدام الدمبل. يستهدف أساسًا أكتاف مع نمط عزل العضلة المستهدفة، ويُفضّل تطبيق خطوات المصدر بمدى متحكم وتنفس منتظم. وتشارك معه باي.
instructions: Grab a dumbbell in each arm and stand up straight with your arms extended by your sides with a slight bend at the elbows and your back straight. This will be your starting position. Tip: The dumbbell should be next to your thighs with the palm of your hands facing back.

Use your side shoulders to lift the dumbbells as you exhale. The dumbbells should be to the side of the body as you move them up. Continue to lift it until the dumbbells are nearly in line with your chin. Tip: Your elbows should drive the motion. As you lift the dumbbell, your elbow should always be higher than your forearm. Also, keep your torso stationary and pause for a second at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbells back down slowly to the starting position. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructionsAr: اضبط وضعية البداية لتمرين دمبل رفع وجهّز الدمبل قبل بدء التكرار.
ثبّت أكتاف ونفّذ عزل العضلة المستهدفة ببطء مع تطبيق الإشارة التالية: استخدم وزنًا يسمح بمدى كامل وتحكم مستمر.
حافظ على التنفس المنتظم وتوقف عند نهاية المدى المريح دون ألم أو تعويض.
عُد إلى وضع البداية بتحكم، ثم كرّر الحركة مع الحفاظ على نفس الإيقاع.
tips: Keep Shoulders as the focus of Dumbbell Raise; use a load that allows a full, controlled range.

Check the setup before the first repetition of Dumbbell Raise: Grab a dumbbell in each arm and stand up straight with your arms extended by your sides with a slight bend at the elbows and your back straight.
Use a light enough load to keep the shoulders away from the ears and stop at the range you can control. Apply this cue specifically to Dumbbell Raise.
tipsAr: اجعل أكتاف محور تمرين دمبل رفع؛ استخدم وزنًا يسمح بمدى كامل وتحكم مستمر.
قبل أول تكرار من تمرين دمبل رفع راجع وضعية البداية وتأكد من ثباتها.
استخدم وزنًا يسمح بإبعاد الكتفين عن الأذنين وتوقف عند المدى الذي تستطيع التحكم فيه. طبّق هذه الملاحظة على تمرين دمبل رفع.
commonMistakes: Shrugging, swinging, or lifting beyond a comfortable shoulder range to make the repetition look larger. Correct it in Dumbbell Raise before adding load or intensity.

Rushing the setup for Dumbbell Raise and ignoring the documented starting cue: Grab a dumbbell in each arm and stand up straight with your arms extended by your sides with a slight bend at the elbows and your back straight.
Allowing the Shoulders to lose tension during Dumbbell Raise when the load or range is beyond the level you can control.
commonMistakesAr: رفع الكتفين أو التأرجح أو تجاوز المدى المريح للكتف من أجل إكمال تكرار أكبر شكليًا. صحح ذلك في تمرين دمبل رفع قبل زيادة الوزن أو الشدة.
التسرع في بداية تمرين دمبل رفع وتجاهل الوضعية الموثقة للتمرين.
فقدان الشد في أكتاف أثناء تمرين دمبل رفع عندما يكون الوزن أو المدى أكبر من المستوى المتحكم فيه.

name: Dumbbell Rear Lunge
description: Dumbbell Rear Lunge is a intermediate strength movement performed with dumbbell. It primarily targets Quadriceps and uses a lower-body pattern; the listed source steps should be followed with a controlled range and steady breathing. Supporting muscles include Calves, Glutes, Hamstrings.
descriptionAr: تمرين دمبل خلفي Lunge من تمارين القوة، ويُنفَّذ باستخدام الدمبل. يستهدف أساسًا فخذ أمامي مع نمط حركة الرجلين، ويُفضّل تطبيق خطوات المصدر بمدى متحكم وتنفس منتظم. وتشارك معه سمانة، مؤخرة، فخذ خلفي.
instructions: Stand with your torso upright holding two dumbbells in your hands by your sides. This will be your starting position.

Step backward with your right leg around two feet or so from the left foot and lower your upper body down, while keeping the torso upright and maintaining balance. Inhale as you go down. Tip: As in the other exercises, do not allow your knee to go forward beyond your toes as you come down, as this will put undue stress on the knee joint. Make sure that you keep your front shin perpendicular to the ground. Keep the torso upright during the lunge; flexible hip flexors are important. A long lunge emphasizes the Gluteus Maximus; a short lunge emphasizes Quadriceps.
Push up and go back to the starting position as you exhale. Tip: Use the ball of your feet to push in order to accentuate the quadriceps. To focus on the glutes, press with your heels.
Now repeat with the opposite leg.

حافظ على التنفس المنتظم وتوقف عند نهاية المدى المريح دون ألم أو تعويض.
عُد إلى وضع البداية بتحكم، ثم كرّر الحركة مع الحفاظ على نفس الإيقاع.
tips: Keep Quadriceps as the focus of Dumbbell Rear Lunge; keep the knees tracking with the feet.
Check the setup before the first repetition of Dumbbell Rear Lunge: Stand with your torso upright holding two dumbbells in your hands by your sides.
Keep the whole foot connected to the floor and let the knees follow the same direction as the toes through the full range. Apply this cue specifically to Dumbbell Rear Lunge.
tipsAr: اجعل فخذ أمامي محور تمرين دمبل خلفي Lunge؛ حافظ على اتجاه الركبة مع اتجاه القدم.
قبل أول تكرار من تمرين دمبل خلفي Lunge راجع وضعية البداية وتأكد من ثباتها.
ثبت القدم كاملة على الأرض ودع الركبتين تتحركان في اتجاه أصابع القدم خلال المدى المتاح. طبّق هذه الملاحظة على تمرين دمبل خلفي Lunge.
commonMistakes: Allowing the knees to collapse inward, lifting the heels, or cutting the range to use more load than you can control. Correct it in Dumbbell Rear Lunge before adding load or intensity.
Rushing the setup for Dumbbell Rear Lunge and ignoring the documented starting cue: Stand with your torso upright holding two dumbbells in your hands by your sides.
Allowing the Quadriceps to lose tension during Dumbbell Rear Lunge when the load or range is beyond the level you can control.
commonMistakesAr: دخول الركبتين للداخل أو رفع الكعبين أو تقليل المدى لاستخدام وزن أكبر من قدرتك على التحكم. صحح ذلك في تمرين دمبل خلفي Lunge قبل زيادة الوزن أو الشدة.

instructions: Position a box a couple feet to the side of a bench. Hold a dumbbell to your chest with both hands and seat yourself on the bench facing the box. This will be your starting position.
Plant your feet firmly on the ground as you lean forward, extending through the hips and knees to jump up and forward.
Land on the box with both feet, absorbing the impact by allowing the hips and knees to bend.
Step down and return to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
description: Dumbbell Shoulder Press is a intermediate strength movement performed with dumbbell. It primarily targets Shoulders and uses a controlled press; the listed source steps should be followed with a controlled range and steady breathing. Supporting muscles include Triceps.
descriptionAr: تمرين دمبل كتف ضغط من تمارين القوة، ويُنفَّذ باستخدام الدمبل. يستهدف أساسًا أكتاف مع نمط الدفع، ويُفضّل تطبيق خطوات المصدر بمدى متحكم وتنفس منتظم. وتشارك معه تراي.
instructions: While holding a dumbbell in each hand, sit on a military press bench or utility bench that has back support. Place the dumbbells upright on top of your thighs.
Now raise the dumbbells to shoulder height one at a time using your thighs to help propel them up into position.
Make sure to rotate your wrists so that the palms of your hands are facing forward. This is your starting position.
Now, exhale and push the dumbbells upward until they touch at the top.
Then, after a brief pause at the top contracted position, slowly lower the weights back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

descriptionAr: تمرين دمبل سكوات من تمارين القوة، ويُنفَّذ باستخدام الدمبل. يستهدف أساسًا فخذ أمامي مع نمط حركة الرجلين، ويُفضّل تطبيق خطوات المصدر بمدى متحكم وتنفس منتظم. وتشارك معه سمانة، مؤخرة، فخذ خلفي، أسفل الظهر.
instructions: Stand up straight while holding a dumbbell on each hand (palms facing the side of your legs).

Position your legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Keep your head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a straight back. This will be your starting position. Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances discussed in the foot stances section.

Begin to slowly lower your torso by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up. Continue down until your thighs are parallel to the floor. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
Begin to raise your torso as you exhale by pushing the floor with the heel of your foot mainly as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

حافظ على التنفس المنتظم وتوقف عند نهاية المدى المريح دون ألم أو تعويض.
عُد إلى وضع البداية بتحكم، ثم كرّر الحركة مع الحفاظ على نفس الإيقاع.

name: Elevated Cable Rows
description: Elevated Cable Rows is a intermediate strength movement performed with cable. It primarily targets Lats and uses a controlled pull; the listed source steps should be followed with a controlled range and steady breathing. Supporting muscles include Middle Back, Traps.
descriptionAr: تمرين مرتفع كابل تجديف من تمارين القوة، ويُنفَّذ باستخدام الكابل. يستهدف أساسًا مجنص مع نمط السحب، ويُفضّل تطبيق خطوات المصدر بمدى متحكم وتنفس منتظم. وتشارك معه ظهر أوسط، ترابيس.
instructions: Get a platform of some sort (it can be an aerobics or calf raise platform) that is around 4-6 inches in height.
Place it on the seat of the cable row machine.
Sit down on the machine and place your feet on the front platform or crossbar provided making sure that your knees are slightly bent and not locked.
Lean over as you keep the natural alignment of your back and grab the V-bar handles.

With your arms extended pull back until your torso is at a 90-degree angle from your legs. Your back should be slightly arched and your chest should be sticking out. You should be feeling a nice stretch on your lats as you hold the bar in front of you. This is the starting position of the exercise.

Keeping the torso stationary, pull the handles back towards your torso while keeping the arms close to it until you touch the abdominals. Breathe out as you perform that movement. At that point you should be squeezing your back muscles hard. Hold that contraction for a second and slowly go back to the original position while breathing in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructionsAr: اضبط وضعية البداية لتمرين مرتفع كابل تجديف وجهّز الكابل قبل بدء التكرار.
ثبّت مجنص ونفّذ السحب ببطء مع تطبيق الإشارة التالية: ابدأ الحركة بالمرفقين وتجنّب رفع الكتفين.
حافظ على التنفس المنتظم وتوقف عند نهاية المدى المريح دون ألم أو تعويض.
عُد إلى وضع البداية بتحكم، ثم كرّر الحركة مع الحفاظ على نفس الإيقاع.
tips: Keep Lats as the focus of Elevated Cable Rows; initiate with the elbows and avoid shrugging.
Check the setup before the first repetition of Elevated Cable Rows: Get a platform of some sort (it can be an aerobics or calf raise platform) that is around 4-6 inches in height.
Pull toward the intended line of the row and pause when the shoulder blades finish moving, not when the hands simply reach the body. Apply this cue specifically to Elevated Cable Rows.
tipsAr: اجعل مجنص محور تمرين مرتفع كابل تجديف؛ ابدأ الحركة بالمرفقين وتجنّب رفع الكتفين.
قبل أول تكرار من تمرين مرتفع كابل تجديف راجع وضعية البداية وتأكد من ثباتها.
اسحب في مسار التجديف الصحيح وتوقف عند اكتمال حركة لوحي الكتف، وليس بمجرد وصول اليدين للجسم. طبّق هذه الملاحظة على تمرين مرتفع كابل تجديف.
commonMistakes: Shrugging or rotating the torso to finish the row instead of keeping the chest and shoulders controlled. Correct it in Elevated Cable Rows before adding load or intensity.
Rushing the setup for Elevated Cable Rows and ignoring the documented starting cue: Get a platform of some sort (it can be an aerobics or calf raise platform) that is around 4-6 inches in height.
Allowing the Lats to lose tension during Elevated Cable Rows when the load or range is beyond the level you can control.
commonMistakesAr: رفع الكتفين أو لف الجذع لإنهاء التجديف بدل الحفاظ على تحكم الصدر والكتفين. صحح ذلك في تمرين مرتفع كابل تجديف قبل زيادة الوزن أو الشدة.

name: Exercise Ball Crunch
description: Exercise Ball Crunch is a beginner strength movement performed with exercise ball. It primarily targets Abs and uses a trunk-control pattern; the listed source steps should be followed with a controlled range and steady breathing. Supporting muscles include the supporting muscles listed by the source.
descriptionAr: تمرين Exercise Ball كرنش من تمارين القوة، ويُنفَّذ باستخدام كرة التمرين. يستهدف أساسًا بطن مع نمط تثبيت الجذع، ويُفضّل تطبيق خطوات المصدر بمدى متحكم وتنفس منتظم. وتشارك معه العضلات المساعدة المذكورة في المصدر.
instructions: Lie on an exercise ball with your lower back curvature pressed against the spherical surface of the ball. Your feet should be bent at the knee and pressed firmly against the floor. The upper torso should be hanging off the top of the ball. The arms should either be kept alongside the body or crossed on top of your chest as these positions avoid neck strains (as opposed to the hands behind the back of the head position).
Lower your torso into a stretch position keeping the neck stationary at all times. This will be your starting position.

With the hips stationary, flex the waist by contracting the abdominals and curl the shoulders and trunk upward until you feel a nice contraction on your abdominals. The arms should simply slide up the side of your legs if you have them at the side or just stay on top of your chest if you have them crossed. The lower back should always stay in contact with the ball. Exhale as you perform this movement and hold the contraction for a second.
As you inhale, go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructionsAr: اضبط وضعية البداية لتمرين Exercise Ball كرنش وجهّز كرة التمرين قبل بدء التكرار.
ثبّت بطن ونفّذ تثبيت الجذع ببطء مع تطبيق الإشارة التالية: ثبّت القفص الصدري وتجنّب استخدام الزخم.
حافظ على التنفس المنتظم وتوقف عند نهاية المدى المريح دون ألم أو تعويض.
عُد إلى وضع البداية بتحكم، ثم كرّر الحركة مع الحفاظ على نفس الإيقاع.
tips: Keep Abs as the focus of Exercise Ball Crunch; brace the ribcage and avoid momentum.
Check the setup before the first repetition of Exercise Ball Crunch: Lie on an exercise ball with your lower back curvature pressed against the spherical surface of the ball.
Brace the ribs and pelvis together, then move only through the range that keeps the trunk under control. Apply this cue specifically to Exercise Ball Crunch.

قبل أول تكرار من تمرين Exercise Ball كرنش راجع وضعية البداية وتأكد من ثباتها.

commonMistakes: Pulling with the neck, arching the lower back, or using speed to finish a core repetition. Correct it in Exercise Ball Crunch before adding load or intensity.
Rushing the setup for Exercise Ball Crunch and ignoring the documented starting cue: Lie on an exercise ball with your lower back curvature pressed against the spherical surface of the ball.
Allowing the Abs to lose tension during Exercise Ball Crunch when the load or range is beyond the level you can control.

instructions: Place an exercise ball nearby and lay on the floor in front of it with your hands on the floor shoulder width apart in a push-up position.

While keeping your back completely straight and the upper body stationary, pull your knees in towards your chest as you exhale, allowing the ball to roll forward under your ankles. Squeeze your abs and hold that position for a second.
Now slowly straighten your legs, rolling the ball back to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

instructions: Lie on the floor and position a kettlebell for one arm to press. The kettlebell should be held by the handle. The leg on the same side that you are pressing should be bent, with the knee crossing over the midline of the body.
Press the kettlebell by extending the elbow and adducting the arm, pressing it above your body. Return to the starting position.
instructionsAr: اضبط وضعية البداية لتمرين Extended Range One-Arm كتل بيل Floor ضغط وجهّز kettlebells قبل بدء التكرار.

name: External Rotation
description: External Rotation is a beginner strength movement performed with dumbbell. It primarily targets Shoulders and uses a mobility pattern; the listed source steps should be followed with a controlled range and steady breathing. Supporting muscles include the supporting muscles listed by the source.
descriptionAr: تمرين خارجي دوران من تمارين القوة، ويُنفَّذ باستخدام الدمبل. يستهدف أساسًا أكتاف مع نمط الحركة والإطالة، ويُفضّل تطبيق خطوات المصدر بمدى متحكم وتنفس منتظم. وتشارك معه العضلات المساعدة المذكورة في المصدر.
instructions: Lie sideways on a flat bench with one arm holding a dumbbell and the other hand on top of the bench folded so that you can rest your head on it.
Bend the elbows of the arm holding the dumbbell so that it creates a 90-degree angle between the upper arm and the forearm. Tip: Keep the arm parallel to your torso.

Now bend the elbow while keeping the upper arm stationary. In this manner, the forearm will be parallel to the floor and perpendicular to your torso (Tip: So the forearm will be directly in front of you). The upper arm will be stationary by your torso and should be parallel to the floor (aligned with your torso at all times). This will be your starting position.

As you breathe out, externally rotate your forearm so that the dumbbell is lifted up in a semicircle motion as you maintain the 90 degree angle bend between the upper arms and the forearm. You will continue this external rotation until the forearm is perpendicular to the floor and the torso pointing towards the ceiling. At this point you will hold the contraction for a second.
As you breathe in, slowly go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and then switch to the other arm.

عُد إلى وضع البداية بتحكم، ثم كرّر الحركة مع الحفاظ على نفس الإيقاع.

descriptionAr: تمرين خارجي دوران with شريط مقاومة من تمارين القوة، ويُنفَّذ باستخدام أشرطة المقاومة. يستهدف أساسًا أكتاف مع نمط الحركة والإطالة، ويُفضّل تطبيق خطوات المصدر بمدى متحكم وتنفس منتظم. وتشارك معه العضلات المساعدة المذكورة في المصدر.
instructions: Choke the band around a post. The band should be at the same height as your elbow. Stand with your left side to the band a couple of feet away.
Grasp the end of the band with your right hand, and keep your elbow pressed firmly to your side. We recommend you hold a pad or foam roll in place with your elbow to keep it firmly in position.
With your upper arm in position, your elbow should be flexed to 90 degrees with your hand reaching across the front of your torso. This will be your starting position.
Execute the movement by rotating your arm in a backhand motion, keeping your elbow in place.
Continue as far as you are able, pause, and then return to the starting position.
instructionsAr: اضبط وضعية البداية لتمرين خارجي دوران with شريط مقاومة وجهّز أشرطة المقاومة قبل بدء التكرار.
ثبّت أكتاف ونفّذ الحركة والإطالة ببطء مع تطبيق الإشارة التالية: تحرك داخل مدى مريح وتوقف قبل الألم.
حافظ على التنفس المنتظم وتوقف عند نهاية المدى المريح دون ألم أو تعويض.
عُد إلى وضع البداية بتحكم، ثم كرّر الحركة مع الحفاظ على نفس الإيقاع.
tips: Keep Shoulders as the focus of External Rotation with Band; move through a comfortable range and stop before pain.
Check the setup before the first repetition of External Rotation with Band: Choke the band around a post.
Brace the ribs and pelvis together, then move only through the range that keeps the trunk under control. Apply this cue specifically to External Rotation with Band.
tipsAr: اجعل أكتاف محور تمرين خارجي دوران with شريط مقاومة؛ تحرك داخل مدى مريح وتوقف قبل الألم.
قبل أول تكرار من تمرين خارجي دوران with شريط مقاومة راجع وضعية البداية وتأكد من ثباتها.
ثبت القفص الصدري والحوض معًا ثم تحرك فقط داخل المدى الذي يحافظ على تحكم الجذع. طبّق هذه الملاحظة على تمرين خارجي دوران with شريط مقاومة.
commonMistakes: Pulling with the neck, arching the lower back, or using speed to finish a core repetition. Correct it in External Rotation with Band before adding load or intensity.
Rushing the setup for External Rotation with Band and ignoring the documented starting cue: Choke the band around a post.
Allowing the Shoulders to lose tension during External Rotation with Band when the load or range is beyond the level you can control.
commonMistakesAr: السحب بالرقبة أو تقويس أسفل الظهر أو استخدام السرعة لإنهاء تكرار البطن. صحح ذلك في تمرين خارجي دوران with شريط مقاومة قبل زيادة الوزن أو الشدة.

فقدان الشد في أكتاف أثناء تمرين خارجي دوران with شريط مقاومة عندما يكون الوزن أو المدى أكبر من المستوى المتحكم فيه.

instructions: Start in a relaxed position with one leg slightly forward. This will be your starting position.
Skip by executing a step-hop pattern of right-right-step to left-left-step, and so on, alternating back and forth.
Perform fast skips by maintaining close contact with the ground and reduce air time, moving as quickly as possible.

description: Finger Curls is a beginner strength movement performed with barbell. It primarily targets Forearms and uses an elbow-flexion pattern; the listed source steps should be followed with a controlled range and steady breathing. Supporting muscles include the supporting muscles listed by the source.
descriptionAr: تمرين أصابع كيرل من تمارين القوة، ويُنفَّذ باستخدام البار. يستهدف أساسًا ساعد مع نمط ثني الذراع، ويُفضّل تطبيق خطوات المصدر بمدى متحكم وتنفس منتظم. وتشارك معه العضلات المساعدة المذكورة في المصدر.
instructions: Hold a barbell with both hands and your palms facing up; hands spaced about shoulder width.
Place your feet flat on the floor, at a distance that is slightly wider than shoulder width apart. This will be your starting position.
Lower the bar as far as possible by extending the fingers. Allowing the bar to roll down the hands, catch the bar with the final joint in the fingers.
Now curl bar up as high as possible by closing your hands while exhaling. Hold the contraction at the top.
instructionsAr: اضبط وضعية البداية لتمرين أصابع كيرل وجهّز البار قبل بدء التكرار.
ثبّت ساعد ونفّذ ثني الذراع ببطء مع تطبيق الإشارة التالية: ثبّت المرفق قريبًا من الجسم واعصر العضلة في النهاية.
حافظ على التنفس المنتظم وتوقف عند نهاية المدى المريح دون ألم أو تعويض.
عُد إلى وضع البداية بتحكم، ثم كرّر الحركة مع الحفاظ على نفس الإيقاع.
tips: Keep Forearms as the focus of Finger Curls; keep the elbow steady and squeeze at the top.
Check the setup before the first repetition of Finger Curls: Hold a barbell with both hands and your palms facing up; hands spaced about shoulder width.
Keep the elbows quiet and lower the weight slowly until the arm is lengthened without losing shoulder position. Apply this cue specifically to Finger Curls.
tipsAr: اجعل ساعد محور تمرين أصابع كيرل؛ ثبّت المرفق قريبًا من الجسم واعصر العضلة في النهاية.
قبل أول تكرار من تمرين أصابع كيرل راجع وضعية البداية وتأكد من ثباتها.

commonMistakes: Swinging the torso or rolling the shoulders forward to start the curl instead of loading the elbow flexors. Correct it in Finger Curls before adding load or intensity.
Rushing the setup for Finger Curls and ignoring the documented starting cue: Hold a barbell with both hands and your palms facing up; hands spaced about shoulder width.

name: Flat Bench Cable Flyes
description: Flat Bench Cable Flyes is a intermediate strength movement performed with cable. It primarily targets Chest and uses a controlled pull; the listed source steps should be followed with a controlled range and steady breathing. Supporting muscles include the supporting muscles listed by the source.
descriptionAr: تمرين مستوٍ بنش كابل تفتيح من تمارين القوة، ويُنفَّذ باستخدام الكابل. يستهدف أساسًا صدر مع نمط السحب، ويُفضّل تطبيق خطوات المصدر بمدى متحكم وتنفس منتظم. وتشارك معه العضلات المساعدة المذكورة في المصدر.
instructions: Position a flat bench between two low pulleys so that when you are laying on it, your chest will be lined up with the cable pulleys.
Lay flat on the bench and keep your feet on the ground.
Have someone hand you the handles on each hand. You will grab each single handle attachment with a palms up grip.

Extend your arms by your side with a slight bend on your elbows. Tip: You will keep this bend constant through the whole movement. Your arms should be parallel to the floor. This is your starting position.

Now start lifting the arms in a semi-circle motion directly in front of you by pulling the cables together until both hands meet at the top of the movement. Squeeze your chest as you perform this motion and breathe out during this movement. Also, hold the contraction for a second at the top. Tip: When performed correctly, at the top position of this movement, your arms should be perpendicular to your torso and the floor touching above your chest.
Slowly come back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructionsAr: اضبط وضعية البداية لتمرين مستوٍ بنش كابل تفتيح وجهّز الكابل قبل بدء التكرار.
ثبّت صدر ونفّذ السحب ببطء مع تطبيق الإشارة التالية: ابدأ الحركة بالمرفقين وتجنّب رفع الكتفين.
حافظ على التنفس المنتظم وتوقف عند نهاية المدى المريح دون ألم أو تعويض.
عُد إلى وضع البداية بتحكم، ثم كرّر الحركة مع الحفاظ على نفس الإيقاع.
tips: Keep Chest as the focus of Flat Bench Cable Flyes; initiate with the elbows and avoid shrugging.

Check the setup before the first repetition of Flat Bench Cable Flyes: Position a flat bench between two low pulleys so that when you are laying on it, your chest will be lined up with the cable pulleys.
Keep a soft elbow bend and move through a controlled arc instead of turning the fly into a press. Apply this cue specifically to Flat Bench Cable Flyes.
tipsAr: اجعل صدر محور تمرين مستوٍ بنش كابل تفتيح؛ ابدأ الحركة بالمرفقين وتجنّب رفع الكتفين.
قبل أول تكرار من تمرين مستوٍ بنش كابل تفتيح راجع وضعية البداية وتأكد من ثباتها.
حافظ على ثني خفيف في المرفق وحرك الذراعين في قوس متحكم بدل تحويل التفتيح إلى ضغط. طبّق هذه الملاحظة على تمرين مستوٍ بنش كابل تفتيح.
commonMistakes: Straightening the elbows or shortening the arc, which increases joint stress and changes the purpose of the fly. Correct it in Flat Bench Cable Flyes before adding load or intensity.

description: Flexor Incline Dumbbell Curls is a beginner strength movement performed with dumbbell. It primarily targets Biceps and uses an elbow-flexion pattern; the listed source steps should be followed with a controlled range and steady breathing. Supporting muscles include the supporting muscles listed by the source.
descriptionAr: تمرين Flexor مائل لأعلى دمبل كيرل من تمارين القوة، ويُنفَّذ باستخدام الدمبل. يستهدف أساسًا باي مع نمط ثني الذراع، ويُفضّل تطبيق خطوات المصدر بمدى متحكم وتنفس منتظم. وتشارك معه العضلات المساعدة المذكورة في المصدر.
instructions: Hold the dumbbell towards the side farther from you so that you have more weight on the side closest to you. (This can be done for a good effect on all bicep dumbbell exercises). Now do a normal incline dumbbell curl, but keep your wrists as far back as possible so as to neutralize any stress that is placed on them.
Sit on an incline bench that is angled at 45-degrees while holding a dumbbell on each hand.

Let your arms hang down on your sides, with the elbows in, and turn the palms of your hands forward with the thumbs pointing away from the body. Tip: You will keep this hand position throughout the movement as there should not be any twisting of the hands as they come up. This will be your starting position.

Curl up the two dumbbells at the same time until your biceps are fully contracted and exhale. Tip: Do not swing the arms or use momentum. Keep a controlled motion at all times. Hold the contracted position for a second at the top.
As you inhale, slowly go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Keep the elbows quiet and lower the weight slowly until the arm is lengthened without losing shoulder position. Apply this cue specifically to Flexor Incline Dumbbell Curls.

Place your hands in front of you as you reach the floor. This movement is very difficult and you may be unable to do it unaided. Use your arms to lightly push off the floor to aid your return to the starting position.

instructions: Adjust the j-hooks so they are at the appropriate height to rack the bar. Begin lying on the floor with your head near the end of a power rack. Keeping your shoulder blades pulled together; pull the bar off of the hooks.

Lower the bar until your upper arm contacts the ground and pause, preventing any slamming or bouncing of the weight.
Press the bar back up as fast as you can, keeping the bar, your wrists, and elbows in line as you do so.

description: Frankenstein Squat is a intermediate olympic weightlifting movement performed with barbell. It primarily targets Quadriceps and uses a lower-body pattern; the listed source steps should be followed with a controlled range and steady breathing. Supporting muscles include Abs, Calves, Glutes, Hamstrings.
descriptionAr: تمرين Frankenstein سكوات من تمارين olympic weightlifting، ويُنفَّذ باستخدام البار. يستهدف أساسًا فخذ أمامي مع نمط حركة الرجلين، ويُفضّل تطبيق خطوات المصدر بمدى متحكم وتنفس منتظم. وتشارك معه بطن، سمانة، مؤخرة، فخذ خلفي.
instructions: This drill teaches you the proper positioning of both the bar and your body during the clean and front squat.

Place the barbell on the front of the shoulders, releasing your grip and extending your arms out in front of you. The shoulders should be pushed forward to create a shelf, and the bar should be in contact with the throat. Ensure that you only move your shoulder blades forward; don't round the thoracic spine.

Squat by flexing the knees and hips, sitting in between your legs. Keep the torso upright, the arms up, and the shoulders forward, and the bar should stay in place. Go to the bottom of the squat, until your hamstrings contact your calves.
Return to the upright position by driving through the front of the heel and extending the knees and hips.

حافظ على التنفس المنتظم وتوقف عند نهاية المدى المريح دون ألم أو تعويض.
عُد إلى وضع البداية بتحكم، ثم كرّر الحركة مع الحفاظ على نفس الإيقاع.

description: Frog Sit-Ups is a intermediate strength movement performed with bodyweight. It primarily targets Abs and uses a trunk-control pattern; the listed source steps should be followed with a controlled range and steady breathing. instructions: Lie with your back flat on the floor (or exercise mat) and your legs extended in front of you.
Now bend at the knees and place your outer thighs by the floor (or mat) as you make the soles of your feet touch each other.

Now try pushing both soles and bringing them up as near you as possible while you keep the outer thighs on the floor (or at least almost touching it). Tip: In this position your legs should create a diamond shape.
Now, cross your arms in front of you by touching the opposite shoulders. This will be your starting position.
As you exhale flatten your lower back to the floor while curling the torso upwards. Tip: This will be like performing the first 1/4 movement of a sit up. Hold at the top position for a second.
As you inhale, slowly lower back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Brace the ribs and pelvis together, then move only through the range that keeps the trunk under control. Apply this cue specifically to Frog Sit-Ups.

descriptionAr: تمرين أمامي بار سكوات من تمارين القوة، ويُنفَّذ باستخدام البار. يستهدف أساسًا فخذ أمامي مع نمط حركة الرجلين، ويُفضّل تطبيق خطوات المصدر بمدى متحكم وتنفس منتظم. وتشارك معه سمانة، مؤخرة، فخذ خلفي.
instructions: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, bring your arms up under the bar while keeping the elbows high and the upper arm slightly above parallel to the floor. Rest the bar on top of the deltoids and cross your arms while grasping the bar for total control.
Lift the bar off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.

Step away from the rack and position your legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Keep your head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a straight back. This will be your starting position. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances described in the foot positioning section).

Begin to slowly lower the bar by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up. Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below parallel to the floor). Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor mainly with the middle of your foot as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

instructions: Either standing or seated on a high bench, grasp two stirrup cables that are attached to the high pulleys. Grab with the opposing hand so your arms are crisscrossed about you and your palms are facing forward.

Keeping your chest up and maintaining a slight arch in your lower back, pull the handles down as if you were doing a regular pulldown. The range of motion will be more of an arc. instructions: Kneel on the floor or an exercise mat and bend at the waist with your arms extended in front of you (perpendicular to the torso) in order to get into a kneeling push-up position but with the arms spaced at shoulder width. Contract the glutes throughout this movement and hold the contraction at the top for a second. Tip: At the end of the movement the upper leg should be parallel to the floor while the calf should be perpendicular to it.
Go back to the initial position as you inhale and now repeat with the left leg.

instructions: Stand holding a light kettlebell by the horns close to your chest. This will be your starting position.

At the bottom position, pause and use your elbows to push your knees out. Return to the starting position, and repeat for 10-20 repetitions.

name: Good Morning
description: Good Morning is a intermediate powerlifting movement performed with barbell. It primarily targets Hamstrings and uses a hip-hinge pattern; the listed source steps should be followed with a controlled range and steady breathing. Supporting muscles include Abs, Glutes, Lower Back.
descriptionAr: تمرين Good Morning من تمارين الباور لفتينج، ويُنفَّذ باستخدام البار. يستهدف أساسًا فخذ خلفي مع نمط مفصل الورك، ويُفضّل تطبيق خطوات المصدر بمدى متحكم وتنفس منتظم. وتشارك معه بطن، مؤخرة، أسفل الظهر.
instructions: Begin with a bar on a rack at shoulder height. Rack the bar across the rear of your shoulders as you would a power squat, not on top of your shoulders. Keep your back tight, shoulder blades pinched together, and your knees slightly bent. Step back from the rack.
Begin by bending at the hips, moving them back as you bend over to near parallel. Keep your back arched and your cervical spine in proper alignment.
Reverse the motion by extending through the hips with your glutes and hamstrings. Continue until you have returned to the starting position.

name: Gorilla Chin/Crunch
description: Gorilla Chin/Crunch is a intermediate strength movement performed with bodyweight. It primarily targets Abs and uses a trunk-control pattern; the listed source steps should be followed with a controlled range and steady breathing. Supporting muscles include Biceps, Lats.
descriptionAr: تمرين Gorilla Chin/Crunch من تمارين القوة، ويُنفَّذ باستخدام وزن الجسم. يستهدف أساسًا بطن مع نمط تثبيت الجذع، ويُفضّل تطبيق خطوات المصدر بمدى متحكم وتنفس منتظم. وتشارك معه باي، مجنص.
instructions: Hang from a chin-up bar using an underhand grip (palms facing you) that is slightly wider than shoulder width.
Now bend your knees at a 90 degree angle so that the calves are parallel to the floor while the thighs remain perpendicular to it. This will be your starting position.

As you exhale, pull yourself up while crunching your knees up at the same time until your knees are at chest level. You will stop going up as soon as your nose is at the same level as the bar. Tip: When you get to this point you should also be finishing the crunch at the same time.
Slowly start to inhale as you return to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructionsAr: اضبط وضعية البداية لتمرين Gorilla Chin/Crunch وجهّز وزن الجسم قبل بدء التكرار.

حافظ على التنفس المنتظم وتوقف عند نهاية المدى المريح دون ألم أو تعويض.
عُد إلى وضع البداية بتحكم، ثم كرّر الحركة مع الحفاظ على نفس الإيقاع.
tips: Keep Abs as the focus of Gorilla Chin/Crunch; brace the ribcage and avoid momentum.

name: Hack Squat
description: Hack Squat is a beginner strength movement performed with machine. It primarily targets Quadriceps and uses a lower-body pattern; the listed source steps should be followed with a controlled range and steady breathing. Supporting muscles include Calves, Glutes, Hamstrings.
descriptionAr: تمرين Hack سكوات من تمارين القوة، ويُنفَّذ باستخدام الجهاز. يستهدف أساسًا فخذ أمامي مع نمط حركة الرجلين، ويُفضّل تطبيق خطوات المصدر بمدى متحكم وتنفس منتظم. وتشارك معه سمانة، مؤخرة، فخذ خلفي.
instructions: Place the back of your torso against the back pad of the machine and hook your shoulders under the shoulder pads provided.
Position your legs in the platform using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Tip: Keep your head up at all times and also maintain the back on the pad at all times.
Place your arms on the side handles of the machine and disengage the safety bars (which on most designs is done by moving the side handles from a facing front position to a diagonal position).

Now straighten your legs without locking the knees. This will be your starting position. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances described in the foot positioning section).

Begin to slowly lower the unit by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up (back on the pad at all times). Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below parallel to the floor). Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
Begin to raise the unit as you exhale by pushing the floor with mainly with the heel of your foot as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructionsAr: اضبط وضعية البداية لتمرين Hack سكوات وجهّز الجهاز قبل بدء التكرار.
ثبّت فخذ أمامي ونفّذ حركة الرجلين ببطء مع تطبيق الإشارة التالية: حافظ على اتجاه الركبة مع اتجاه القدم.
حافظ على التنفس المنتظم وتوقف عند نهاية المدى المريح دون ألم أو تعويض.
عُد إلى وضع البداية بتحكم، ثم كرّر الحركة مع الحفاظ على نفس الإيقاع.
tips: Keep Quadriceps as the focus of Hack Squat; keep the knees tracking with the feet.
Check the setup before the first repetition of Hack Squat: Place the back of your torso against the back pad of the machine and hook your shoulders under the shoulder pads provided.
Keep the whole foot connected to the floor and let the knees follow the same direction as the toes through the full range. Apply this cue specifically to Hack Squat.
tipsAr: اجعل فخذ أمامي محور تمرين Hack سكوات؛ حافظ على اتجاه الركبة مع اتجاه القدم.
قبل أول تكرار من تمرين Hack سكوات راجع وضعية البداية وتأكد من ثباتها.
ثبت القدم كاملة على الأرض ودع الركبتين تتحركان في اتجاه أصابع القدم خلال المدى المتاح. طبّق هذه الملاحظة على تمرين Hack سكوات.
commonMistakes: Allowing the knees to collapse inward, lifting the heels, or cutting the range to use more load than you can control. Correct it in Hack Squat before adding load or intensity.
Rushing the setup for Hack Squat and ignoring the documented starting cue: Place the back of your torso against the back pad of the machine and hook your shoulders under the shoulder pads provided.
Allowing the Quadriceps to lose tension during Hack Squat when the load or range is beyond the level you can control.
commonMistakesAr: دخول الركبتين للداخل أو رفع الكعبين أو تقليل المدى لاستخدام وزن أكبر من قدرتك على التحكم. صحح ذلك في تمرين Hack سكوات قبل زيادة الوزن أو الشدة.
التسرع في بداية تمرين Hack سكوات وتجاهل الوضعية الموثقة للتمرين.

name: Hammer Curls
description: Hammer Curls is a beginner strength movement performed with dumbbell. It primarily targets Biceps and uses an elbow-flexion pattern; the listed source steps should be followed with a controlled range and steady breathing. Supporting muscles include the supporting muscles listed by the source.
descriptionAr: تمرين Hammer كيرل من تمارين القوة، ويُنفَّذ باستخدام الدمبل. يستهدف أساسًا باي مع نمط ثني الذراع، ويُفضّل تطبيق خطوات المصدر بمدى متحكم وتنفس منتظم. وتشارك معه العضلات المساعدة المذكورة في المصدر.
instructions: Stand up with your torso upright and a dumbbell on each hand being held at arms length. The elbows should be close to the torso.
The palms of the hands should be facing your torso. This will be your starting position.

Now, while holding your upper arm stationary, exhale and curl the weight forward while contracting the biceps. Continue to raise the weight until the biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbell is at shoulder level. Hold the contracted position for a brief moment as you squeeze the biceps. Tip: Focus on keeping the elbow stationary and only moving your forearm.
After the brief pause, inhale and slowly begin the lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructionsAr: اضبط وضعية البداية لتمرين Hammer كيرل وجهّز الدمبل قبل بدء التكرار.

حافظ على التنفس المنتظم وتوقف عند نهاية المدى المريح دون ألم أو تعويض.
عُد إلى وضع البداية بتحكم، ثم كرّر الحركة مع الحفاظ على نفس الإيقاع.
tips: Keep Biceps as the focus of Hammer Curls; keep the elbow steady and squeeze at the top.
Check the setup before the first repetition of Hammer Curls: Stand up with your torso upright and a dumbbell on each hand being held at arms length.
Keep the elbows quiet and lower the weight slowly until the arm is lengthened without losing shoulder position. Apply this cue specifically to Hammer Curls.
tipsAr: اجعل باي محور تمرين Hammer كيرل؛ ثبّت المرفق قريبًا من الجسم واعصر العضلة في النهاية.

ثبت المرفقين وأنزل الوزن ببطء حتى تطول العضلة دون فقدان وضع الكتف. طبّق هذه الملاحظة على تمرين Hammer كيرل.
commonMistakes: Swinging the torso or rolling the shoulders forward to start the curl instead of loading the elbow flexors. Correct it in Hammer Curls before adding load or intensity.

التسرع في بداية تمرين Hammer كيرل وتجاهل الوضعية الموثقة للتمرين.

descriptionAr: تمرين Hammer قبضة مائل لأعلى DB بنش ضغط من تمارين القوة، ويُنفَّذ باستخدام الدمبل. يستهدف أساسًا صدر مع نمط ثني الذراع، ويُفضّل تطبيق خطوات المصدر بمدى متحكم وتنفس منتظم. وتشارك معه أكتاف، تراي.
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench with a dumbbell on each hand on top of your thighs. The palms of your hand will be facing each other.
By using your thighs to help you get the dumbbells up, clean the dumbbells one arm at a time so that you can hold them at shoulder width.

Once at shoulder width, keep the palms of your hands with a neutral grip (palms facing each other). Keep your elbows flared out with the upper arms in line with the shoulders (perpendicular to the torso) and the elbows bent creating a 90-degree angle between the upper arm and the forearm. This will be your starting position.
Now bring down the weights slowly to your side as you breathe in. Keep full control of the dumbbells at all times.

As you breathe out, push the dumbbells up using your pectoral muscles. Lock your arms in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the dumbbells back in your thighs and then on the floor. This is the safest manner to dispose of the dumbbells.

حافظ على التنفس المنتظم وتوقف عند نهاية المدى المريح دون ألم أو تعويض.

description: Handstand Push-Ups is a expert strength movement performed with bodyweight. It primarily targets Shoulders and uses a controlled press; the listed source steps should be followed with a controlled range and steady breathing. Supporting muscles include Triceps.
descriptionAr: تمرين وقوف على اليدين Push-Ups من تمارين القوة، ويُنفَّذ باستخدام وزن الجسم. يستهدف أساسًا أكتاف مع نمط الدفع، ويُفضّل تطبيق خطوات المصدر بمدى متحكم وتنفس منتظم. وتشارك معه تراي.
instructions: With your back to the wall bend at the waist and place both hands on the floor at shoulder width.

Kick yourself up against the wall with your arms straight. Your body should be upside down with the arms and legs fully extended. Keep your whole body as straight as possible. Tip: If doing this for the first time, have a spotter help you. Also, make sure that you keep facing the wall with your head, rather than looking down.
Slowly lower yourself to the ground as you inhale until your head almost touches the floor. Tip: It is of utmost importance that you come down slow in order to avoid head injury.
Push yourself back up slowly as you exhale until your elbows are nearly locked.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

حافظ على التنفس المنتظم وتوقف عند نهاية المدى المريح دون ألم أو تعويض.

Keep the wrists stacked over the elbows in Handstand Push-Ups and finish each repetition without locking out aggressively. Apply this cue specifically to Handstand Push-Ups.

name: Hang Snatch
description: Hang Snatch is a expert olympic weightlifting movement performed with barbell. It primarily targets Hamstrings and uses the listed movement pattern; the listed source steps should be followed with a controlled range and steady breathing. Supporting muscles include Abs, Calves, Forearms, Glutes, Lower Back, Quadriceps, Shoulders, Traps.
descriptionAr: تمرين Hang Snatch من تمارين olympic weightlifting، ويُنفَّذ باستخدام البار. يستهدف أساسًا فخذ خلفي مع نمط الحركة الأساسية، ويُفضّل تطبيق خطوات المصدر بمدى متحكم وتنفس منتظم. وتشارك معه بطن، سمانة، ساعد، مؤخرة، أسفل الظهر، فخذ أمامي، أكتاف، ترابيس.
instructions: Begin with a wide grip on the bar, with an overhand or hook grip. The feet should be directly below the hips with the feet turned out. Your knees should be slightly bent, and the torso inclined forward. The spine should be fully extended and the head facing forward. The bar should be at the hips. This will be your starting position.
Aggressively extend through the legs and hips. At peak extension, shrug the shoulders and allow the elbows to flex to the side.

As you move your feet into the receiving position, forcefully pull yourself below the bar as you elevate the bar overhead. Receive the bar with your body as low as possible and the arms fully extended overhead.

instructions: Lie face down on a hyperextension bench, tucking your ankles securely under the footpads.
Adjust the upper pad if possible so your upper thighs lie flat across the wide pad, leaving enough room for you to bend at the waist without any restriction.

With your body straight, cross your arms in front of you (my preference) or behind your head. This will be your starting position. Tip: You can also hold a weight plate for extra resistance in front of you under your crossed arms.

Start bending forward slowly at the waist as far as you can while keeping your back flat. Inhale as you perform this movement. Keep moving forward until you feel a nice stretch on the hamstrings and you can no longer keep going without a rounding of the back. Tip: Never round the back as you perform this exercise. Also, some people can go farther than others. The key thing is that you go as far as your body allows you to without rounding the back.

Slowly raise your torso back to the initial position as you inhale. Tip: Avoid the temptation to arch your back past a straight line. Also, do not swing the torso at any time in order to protect the back from injury.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

By using your thighs to help you get the dumbbells up, clean the dumbbells one arm at a time so that you can hold them at shoulder width.

Once at shoulder width, keep the palms of your hands with a neutral grip (palms facing each other). Keep your elbows flared out with the upper arms in line with the shoulders (perpendicular to the torso) and the elbows bent creating a 90-degree angle between the upper arm and the forearm. Now bring down the weights slowly to your side as you breathe in. Keep full control of the dumbbells at all times.

As you breathe out, push the dumbbells up using your pectoral muscles. Lock your arms in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

description: Isometric Wipers is a beginner strength movement performed with bodyweight. It primarily targets Chest and uses the listed movement pattern; the listed source steps should be followed with a controlled range and steady breathing. Supporting muscles include Abs, Shoulders, Triceps.
descriptionAr: تمرين ثابت Wipers من تمارين القوة، ويُنفَّذ باستخدام وزن الجسم. يستهدف أساسًا صدر مع نمط الحركة الأساسية، ويُفضّل تطبيق خطوات المصدر بمدى متحكم وتنفس منتظم. وتشارك معه بطن، أكتاف، تراي.
instructions: Assume a push-up position, supporting your weight on your hands and toes while keeping your body straight. Your hands should be just outside of shoulder width. This will be your starting position.
Begin by shifting your body weight as far to one side as possible, allowing the elbow on that side to flex as you lower your body.
Reverse the motion by extending the flexed arm, pushing yourself up and then dropping to the other side.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: JM Press
description: JM Press is a beginner strength movement performed with barbell. It primarily targets Triceps and uses a controlled press; the listed source steps should be followed with a controlled range and steady breathing. Supporting muscles include Chest, Shoulders.
descriptionAr: تمرين JM ضغط من تمارين القوة، ويُنفَّذ باستخدام البار. يستهدف أساسًا تراي مع نمط الدفع، ويُفضّل تطبيق خطوات المصدر بمدى متحكم وتنفس منتظم. وتشارك معه صدر، أكتاف.
instructions: Start the exercise the same way you would a close grip bench press. You will lie on a flat bench while holding a barbell at arms length (fully extended) with the elbows in. However, instead of having the arms perpendicular to the torso, make sure the bar is set in a direct line above the upper chest. This will be your starting position.

Now beginning from a fully extended position lower the bar down as if performing a lying triceps extension. Inhale as you perform this movement. When you reach the half way point, let the bar roll back about one inch by moving the upper arms towards your legs until they are perpendicular to the torso. Tip: Keep the bend at the elbows constant as you bring the upper arms forward.
As you exhale, press the bar back up by using the triceps to perform a close grip bench press.
Now go back to the starting position and start over.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructionsAr: اضبط وضعية البداية لتمرين JM ضغط وجهّز البار قبل بدء التكرار.
ثبّت تراي ونفّذ الدفع ببطء مع تطبيق الإشارة التالية: ثبّت الجذع ووجّه القوة عبر المرفقين.
حافظ على التنفس المنتظم وتوقف عند نهاية المدى المريح دون ألم أو تعويض.
عُد إلى وضع البداية بتحكم، ثم كرّر الحركة مع الحفاظ على نفس الإيقاع.
tips: Keep Triceps as the focus of JM Press; keep the trunk stable and drive through the elbows.
Check the setup before the first repetition of JM Press: Start the exercise the same way you would a close grip bench press.
Keep the wrists stacked over the elbows in JM Press and finish each repetition without locking out aggressively. Apply this cue specifically to JM Press.
tipsAr: اجعل تراي محور تمرين JM ضغط؛ ثبّت الجذع ووجّه القوة عبر المرفقين.
قبل أول تكرار من تمرين JM ضغط راجع وضعية البداية وتأكد من ثباتها.
حافظ على اصطفاف الرسغ فوق المرفق في JM Press وأنهِ التكرار دون قفل عنيف للمفصل. طبّق هذه الملاحظة على تمرين JM ضغط.
commonMistakes: Letting the wrists bend back or the shoulders roll forward during JM Press, especially as fatigue builds. Correct it in JM Press before adding load or intensity.
Rushing the setup for JM Press and ignoring the documented starting cue: Start the exercise the same way you would a close grip bench press.
Allowing the Triceps to lose tension during JM Press when the load or range is beyond the level you can control.

description: Jackknife Sit-Up is a beginner strength movement performed with bodyweight. It primarily targets Abs and uses a trunk-control pattern; the listed source steps should be followed with a controlled range and steady breathing. Supporting muscles include the supporting muscles listed by the source.
descriptionAr: تمرين Jackknife Sit-Up من تمارين القوة، ويُنفَّذ باستخدام وزن الجسم. يستهدف أساسًا بطن مع نمط تثبيت الجذع، ويُفضّل تطبيق خطوات المصدر بمدى متحكم وتنفس منتظم. وتشارك معه العضلات المساعدة المذكورة في المصدر.
instructions: Lie flat on the floor (or exercise mat) on your back with your arms extended straight back behind your head and your legs extended also. This will be your starting position.

As you exhale, bend at the waist while simultaneously raising your legs and arms to meet in a jackknife position. Tip: The legs should be extended and lifted at approximately a 35-45 degree angle from the floor and the arms should be extended and parallel to your legs. The upper torso should be off the floor.
While inhaling, lower your arms and legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

حافظ على التنفس المنتظم وتوقف عند نهاية المدى المريح دون ألم أو تعويض.
عُد إلى وضع البداية بتحكم، ثم كرّر الحركة مع الحفاظ على نفس الإيقاع.
tips: Keep Abs as the focus of Jackknife Sit-Up; brace the ribcage and avoid momentum.

Check the setup before the first repetition of Jackknife Sit-Up: Lie flat on the floor (or exercise mat) on your back with your arms extended straight back behind your head and your legs extended also.
Brace the ribs and pelvis together, then move only through the range that keeps the trunk under control. Apply this cue specifically to Jackknife Sit-Up.

instructions: Position your body on the floor in the basic sit-up position; knees to a ninety degree angle with feet flat on the floor and arms either crossed over your chest or to the sides. This will be your starting position.

As you strongly tighten your glutes and hamstrings, fill your lungs with air and in a slow (three to six second count) ascent, slowly exhale. Tip: It is important to tighten the glutes and hamstrings as this will cause the hip flexors to be inactivated in a process called reciprocal inhibition, which basically means that opposite muscles to the contracted ones will relax.
As you inhale, slowly go back in a controlled manner to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Jefferson Squats
description: Jefferson Squats is a intermediate strength movement performed with barbell. It primarily targets Quadriceps and uses a lower-body pattern; the listed source steps should be followed with a controlled range and steady breathing. Supporting muscles include Calves, Glutes, Hamstrings, Lower Back, Traps.
descriptionAr: تمرين Jefferson Squats من تمارين القوة، ويُنفَّذ باستخدام البار. يستهدف أساسًا فخذ أمامي مع نمط حركة الرجلين، ويُفضّل تطبيق خطوات المصدر بمدى متحكم وتنفس منتظم. وتشارك معه سمانة، مؤخرة، فخذ خلفي، أسفل الظهر، ترابيس.
instructions: Place a barbell on the floor.
Stand in the middle of the bar length wise.
Bend down by bending at the knees and keeping your back straight and grasp the front of the bar with your right hand. Your palm should be in (neutral grip) facing the left side.

Grasp the rear of the bar with your left hand. The palm of your hand should be in neutral grip alignment (palms facing the right side). Tip: Ensure that your grip is even on the bar. Your torso should be positioned right in the middle of the bar and the distance between your torso and your right hand (which should be at the front) should be the same as the distance between your torso and your left hand (which should be to your back).
Now stand straight up with the weight. Tip: Your feet should be shoulder width apart and your toes slightly pointed out.

Squat down by bending at the knees and keeping your back straight until your upper thighs are parallel with the floor. Tip: Keep your back as vertical as possible with the floor and your head up. Also remember to not let your knees go past your toes. Inhale during this portion of the movement.

Now drive yourself back up to the starting position by pushing with the feet . Tip: Keep the bar hanging at arm's length and your elbows locked with a slight bend. The arms only serve as hooks. Avoid doing any lifting with them. Do the lifting with your thighs; not your arms.
instructionsAr: اضبط وضعية البداية لتمرين Jefferson Squats وجهّز البار قبل بدء التكرار.
ثبّت فخذ أمامي ونفّذ حركة الرجلين ببطء مع تطبيق الإشارة التالية: حافظ على اتجاه الركبة مع اتجاه القدم.
حافظ على التنفس المنتظم وتوقف عند نهاية المدى المريح دون ألم أو تعويض.
عُد إلى وضع البداية بتحكم، ثم كرّر الحركة مع الحفاظ على نفس الإيقاع.

instructions: Connect a rope attachment to a high pulley cable and position a mat on the floor in front of it.
Grab the rope with both hands and kneel approximately two feet back from the tower.
Position the rope behind your head with your hands by your ears.
Keep your hands in the same place, contract your abs and pull downward on the rope in a crunching movement until your elbows reach your knees.
Pause briefly at the bottom and rise up in a slow and controlled manner until you reach the starting position.
Repeat the same downward movement until you're halfway down, at which time you'll begin rotating one of your elbows to the opposite knee.
Again, pause briefly at the bottom and rise up in a slow and controlled manner until you reach the starting position.
Repeat the same movement as before, but alternate the other elbow to the opposite knee.
Continue this series of movements to failure.

Supporting muscles include Abductors, Calves, Glutes, Hamstrings, Quadriceps.
descriptionAr: تمرين جانبي Bound من تمارين القدرة الانفجارية، ويُنفَّذ باستخدام وزن الجسم. يستهدف أساسًا العضلات المقربة مع نمط السحب، ويُفضّل تطبيق خطوات المصدر بمدى متحكم وتنفس منتظم. وتشارك معه العضلات المبعدة، سمانة، مؤخرة، فخذ خلفي، فخذ أمامي.
instructions: Assume a half squat position facing 90 degrees from your direction of travel. This will be your starting position.
Allow your lead leg to do a countermovement inward as you shift your weight to the outside leg.
Immediately push off and extend, attempting to bound to the side as far as possible.
Upon landing, immediately push off in the opposite direction, returning to your original start position.
Continue back and forth for several repetitions.

عُد إلى وضع البداية بتحكم، ثم كرّر الحركة مع الحفاظ على نفس الإيقاع.
tips: Keep Adductors as the focus of Lateral Bound; initiate with the elbows and avoid shrugging.
