description: Zottman Curl is a intermediate strength movement performed with dumbbell. It primarily targets Biceps and uses an elbow-flexion pattern; the listed source steps should be followed with a controlled range and steady breathing. Supporting muscles include Forearms.
descriptionAr: تمرين Zottman كيرل من تمارين القوة، ويُنفَّذ باستخدام الدمبل. يستهدف أساسًا باي مع نمط ثني الذراع، ويُفضّل تطبيق خطوات المصدر بمدى متحكم وتنفس منتظم. وتشارك معه ساعد.
instructions: Stand up with your torso upright and a dumbbell in each hand being held at arms length. The elbows should be close to the torso.
Make sure the palms of the hands are facing each other. This will be your starting position.

While holding the upper arm stationary, curl the weights while contracting the biceps as you breathe out. Only the forearms should move. Your wrist should rotate so that you have a supinated (palms up) grip. Continue the movement until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a second as you squeeze the biceps.
Now during the contracted position, rotate your wrist until you now have a pronated (palms facing down) grip with the thumb at a higher position than the pinky.
Slowly begin to bring the dumbbells back down using the pronated grip.
As the dumbbells close your thighs, start rotating the wrist so that you go back to a neutral (palms facing your body) grip.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

description: Zottman Preacher Curl is a intermediate strength movement performed with dumbbell. It primarily targets Biceps and uses an elbow-flexion pattern; the listed source steps should be followed with a controlled range and steady breathing. Supporting muscles include Forearms.
descriptionAr: تمرين Zottman Preacher كيرل من تمارين القوة، ويُنفَّذ باستخدام الدمبل. يستهدف أساسًا باي مع نمط ثني الذراع، ويُفضّل تطبيق خطوات المصدر بمدى متحكم وتنفس منتظم. وتشارك معه ساعد.
instructions: Grab a dumbbell in each hand and place your upper arms on top of the preacher bench or the incline bench. The dumbbells should be held at shoulder height and the elbows should be flexed. Hold the dumbbells with the palms of your hands facing down. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, slowly lower the dumbbells keeping the palms down until your upper arm is extended and your biceps are fully stretched.
Now rotate your wrists once you are at the bottom of the movement so that the palms of the hands are facing up.

As you exhale, use your biceps to curl the weights up until they are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder height. Again, remember that to ensure full contraction you need to bring that small finger higher than the thumb.
Squeeze the biceps hard for a second at the contracted position and rotate your wrists so that the palms are facing down again.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructionsAr: اضبط وضعية البداية لتمرين Zottman Preacher كيرل وجهّز الدمبل قبل بدء التكرار.
ثبّت باي ونفّذ ثني الذراع ببطء مع تطبيق الإشارة التالية: ثبّت المرفق قريبًا من الجسم واعصر العضلة في النهاية.
حافظ على التنفس المنتظم وتوقف عند نهاية المدى المريح دون ألم أو تعويض.
عُد إلى وضع البداية بتحكم، ثم كرّر الحركة مع الحفاظ على نفس الإيقاع.
tips: Keep Biceps as the focus of Zottman Preacher Curl; keep the elbow steady and squeeze at the top.
Check the setup before the first repetition of Zottman Preacher Curl: Grab a dumbbell in each hand and place your upper arms on top of the preacher bench or the incline bench.
Keep the elbows quiet and lower the weight slowly until the arm is lengthened without losing shoulder position. Apply this cue specifically to Zottman Preacher Curl.
tipsAr: اجعل باي محور تمرين Zottman Preacher كيرل؛ ثبّت المرفق قريبًا من الجسم واعصر العضلة في النهاية.
قبل أول تكرار من تمرين Zottman Preacher كيرل راجع وضعية البداية وتأكد من ثباتها.
ثبت المرفقين وأنزل الوزن ببطء حتى تطول العضلة دون فقدان وضع الكتف. طبّق هذه الملاحظة على تمرين Zottman Preacher كيرل.
commonMistakes: Swinging the torso or rolling the shoulders forward to start the curl instead of loading the elbow flexors. Correct it in Zottman Preacher Curl before adding load or intensity.
Rushing the setup for Zottman Preacher Curl and ignoring the documented starting cue: Grab a dumbbell in each hand and place your upper arms on top of the preacher bench or the incline bench.
Allowing the Biceps to lose tension during Zottman Preacher Curl when the load or range is beyond the level you can control.
commonMistakesAr: تحريك الجذع أو تدوير الكتفين للأمام لبدء الكيرل بدل تحميل عضلات ثني المرفق. صحح ذلك في تمرين Zottman Preacher كيرل قبل زيادة الوزن أو الشدة.
التسرع في بداية تمرين Zottman Preacher كيرل وتجاهل الوضعية الموثقة للتمرين.
فقدان الشد في باي أثناء تمرين Zottman Preacher كيرل عندما يكون الوزن أو المدى أكبر من المستوى المتحكم فيه.
